title: Reports
help: Explore gym activity, membership and revenue. Each chart has a data table and CSV download.
noAccess: You do not have permission to view reports.
rangeHelp: Choose up to 24 months, ending no later than the current month. Enter months as YYYY-MM, such as 2026-01. Dates use {timezone}. Current-period counts are provisional.
rangeError: Choose a valid range of 1 to 24 months in the form YYYY-MM, ending no later than the current month.
emptyHelp: Try another range. Any available zero-count periods remain in the table.
chartHelp: The data table immediately below gives every period and value. Negative bars extend below zero.
attendanceHelp: All programs shows totals followed by program rows. Unique members are counted separately in each row; do not add them across programs. Weekly boundary periods can be partial.
membersHelp: New and imported members are separate. Churn counts distinct members active at the month's start who cancel during it, divided by active members at the start, or N/A when that count is zero. Frozen at end counts a member only when every live membership is frozen. Current-period counts are provisional.
revenueHelp: Receipts use their paid month and refunds the month they succeeded. A later reversal counts as a negative refund in its own month, leaving the success month unchanged. Tax has its own group rows. Totals include tax; discounts are negative. Amounts are plain decimals in the currency shown, and currencies are never combined.
